enable.description: Check the consistency of the signals fused from multiple cameras.

publish_partial_matched_signal.description: Publish a signal even when only part of the group's traffic lights agree.

message_lifespan.description: An input message is used for fusion while its stamp is within this many seconds of the latest received message; older ones are discarded.

prior_log_odds.description: Prior log-odds for a traffic light state.

external_delay_tolerance.description: External (V2X) signals whose stamp deviates from the current time by more than this many seconds are rejected.

external_time_tolerance.description: Cached external signals older than this many seconds relative to the reference time are swept.

perception_time_tolerance.description: Cached external signals older than this many seconds relative to the latest perception stamp are swept.

source_priority.description: Which source wins when perception and external disagree. Any value other than the three listed is normalized to 'confidence'.

enable_signal_matching.description: Validate perception signals against external signals before arbitration.

use_last_detect_color.description: Hold the last detected color of a vehicle signal for last_detect_color_hold_time seconds when it becomes UNKNOWN.

use_pedestrian_signal_detect.description: Use the detected pedestrian signals instead of estimating them from the vehicle signals.

last_detect_color_hold_time.description: How long, in seconds, the last detected color is held.

last_colors_hold_time.description: How long, in seconds, the signal color history used for flashing detection is kept.
